DEBUG
SYMPTOM: New setting `hideDockIcon` toggled in UI but never persisted — settings.json always showed false
CAUSE: `_debouncedSaveSettings` in `src/stores/settings-actions.ts` rebuilds the settings object field-by-field (explicit mapping) before sending to backend. Fields not listed are silently dropped. Same issue exists in `loadSettings` which also does explicit field mapping.
FIX: Add new field to BOTH `_debouncedSaveSettings` (preparedSettings object) AND `loadSettings` mapping
PREVENT: Whenever adding a new setting field to AppSettings, grep for `preparedSettings` and `loadSettings` in settings-actions.ts and add the field to both mappings
